system.description:
You collect and build illusionary chakra, attempting to mentally disable the physical strengths of your foes.

Select one creature you can see within range, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist most of this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature is Weakened until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures suffer a -2 penalty to all Strength and Dexterity based attacks and gain a rank of Weakened for the duration.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but the attack roll penalty becomes -4.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1.
